summary: First iteration end-to-end test for My Builder App (Expo + FastAPI). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases passed (auth incl. demo + new-user seeding, project computed totals, line-items CRUD, contacts plan gating 403/200, receipts/media CRUD, upload+download via Emergent object storage, AI estimate ~20-40s returning items/total_low/total_high, Stripe checkout + status). Frontend (390x844): welcome -> sign-in with demo creds -> home (project-hero-card renders with correct Nottingham project), Budget tab (filter chips, add-line-item modal, ai-estimate-banner), Team tab (trades list ok on basic, sub/stakeholder show lock card on basic, both unlock + show add-contact-button + rows on pro), Media tab (3 photos, 3 receipts, upload FAB visible), Profile (plan-toggle-switch wrapper rendered + working through role=switch, upgrade-pro-button present when basic), BRRR Pro screen (£40,750 money-left-in, ROI 8.5%, cashflow, comparables), AI estimate screen (returned £1,660-£2,870 with Add buttons). React Native deprecation detected: shadow* style props on multiple cards (RN Web console warning).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Upgrade to Pro · £19' button is still displayed when user.plan=='pro' but paid_pro==false (e.g. after the plan-toggle-switch flips them to Pro). Condition at /app/frontend/app/profile.tsx:105 uses !user.paid_pro; should also hide when user.plan=='pro' to avoid a misleading CTA while already in Pro preview.

plan-toggle-switch testID is placed on the React Native Switch wrapper but on react-native-web it does not propagate data-testid onto the actual clickable <input role="switch">. Clicking the wrapper via Playwright `[data-testid="plan-toggle-switch"]` does not reliably toggle the control (automation had to fall back to get_by_role('switch')). Reference: /app/frontend/app/profile.tsx:142. Suggest wrapping Switch in a Pressable with testID or exposing an additional testID on the input.

issues: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius in Card/Button styles with boxShadow for RN Web parity.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated shadow* style props produce RN Web console warnings; migrate to boxShadow. Reference: cards/buttons in /app/frontend components.

action_items: Hide upgrade-card when user.plan==='pro' (profile.tsx line 105) to prevent misleading 'Upgrade to Pro' button after the preview toggle is on.
Make plan-toggle-switch testID reachable on web: wrap the Switch in a Pressable with testID='plan-toggle-switch' (keeping the Switch internal) OR verify RN version propagates testID to the <input>.
Replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius with boxShadow across styles to clear RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~660 lines in a single file; still manageable but approaching the recommended 700-line split threshold—consider separating routers (auth/project/contacts/media/payments) into modules.
AI estimate uses regex `{.*}` with DOTALL to extract JSON from LLM output—works but fragile. If Claude ever wraps JSON in markdown fences the current path still works; good resilience.
mark_paid() updates user to paid_pro=true/plan=pro—idempotent via early return if already paid. Good.
/api/files/{path} accepts token both via Bearer and ?token= query—correct for <Image> src usage from the mobile app.
seed_data_creation: No manual seeds created. New-user registration test (TEST_<uuid>@example.com) is auto-seeded by backend; one such account is left in the DB per test run but prefixed with TEST_ for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints are all healthy via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Demo account demo@mybuilder.app/demo1234 is seeded; tests set plan back to basic in a session fixture, but a test may leave it as basic at the end. Pro-only screens (BRRR, comparables, Team subcontractor/stakeholder) require either Stripe-upgrade or toggling plan via POST /api/auth/plan {plan:'pro'}. Note Switch testID issue: use page.get_by_role('switch') for toggling. AI estimate takes ~20-40s; wait up to 60s before asserting result. Upload tests exercise Emergent object storage (STORAGE_URL) and will skip gracefully on 402 credit exhaustion.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no critical bugs. Two low-priority UX/testing issues reported above with proposed fixes referenced to exact file lines.
